public_definitions: Review the renewable generation mix dashboard, identify the largest renewable generation contribution source, then route that source record to escalated contribution review.
Use the dashboard to determine which renewable generation source is the largest contribution source for this routing decision.
Largest renewable generation contribution source: the source with the highest reported production share (%) as shown in the chart.
